body: **Type:** Story · **Area:** Wiki · **Labels:** `area:wiki` · **Status:** Ready (all of Bill's questions answered, 12 Nov 2026) · **Agent:** Alpha1 **Related:** #245 (Set = product vs Set icon = printed symbol; added Ackbar and Piett icons), #244 (added the Set icon row to Template:Card), #276 (ESB Two-Player set icons), #110 (Epic: every Decipher card as printed). **Depends on:** #287 (rebuild the 794 hand-made card pages, 793 of them Japanese, on Template:Card). #287 blocks only the Japanese part of this Story (T4/AC1 for those 794 pages); the other 9,276 pages do not wait for it. ## User story As a wiki reader, I want every card article's infobox to show the set symbol printed on that card, the way [[Admiral Ackbar]] does, so that I can tell at a glance which set a card belongs to, for every Decipher and Virtual card. The symbol should be a clean image with no white square around it, followed by the set's name. ## Background Bill, 12 Nov 2026: "have a user story created to properly put every set icon on every card infobox. this was done to Admiral ackbar but I think we failed to put it everywhere". ### The reference: Admiral Ackbar - Page: https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/Admiral_Ackbar - The icon was added in revision 236534 (Datacard Grok, 10 Nov 2026, 3:23 PM AST, #245). Diff: https://wiki.swccg.com/index.php?diff=236534&oldid=208389 - Wikitext: `|set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Death-Star-II.png|20px|link=Death Star II (expansion)]] [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]]`. - It shows a 20px Death Star II symbol, then the words "Death Star II", in the **Set icon** row under Set (Death Star II Light Side Starter Deck). - I checked Ackbar's own card scan: the symbol to the right of the lore box is the Death Star II symbol, the same as on [[A-wing]]. The picture is in `symbol-checks.png`. ### How big the gap is (read-only audit, 12 Nov 2026, 1:23 PM AST) The audit covered 10,070 card articles: 9,276 that use Template:Card plus 794 pages with hand-made infoboxes: 793 Japanese printings and one oversized promo, [Mara Jade & •Corran Horn & •Talon Karrde](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/Mara_Jade_%26_%E2%80%A2Corran_Horn_%26_%E2%80%A2Talon_Karrde). | Status | Pages | |---|--:| | Image icon (Ackbar standard) | 2 (Ackbar, [[Admiral Piett]]) | | Correct "none" (Premiere family) | 986 | | Empty Set icon cell | 8,207 | | No Set icon row at all (hand-made pages: 793 Japanese + 1 oversized promo) | 794 | | Text link only, no image (ESB Two-Player, Promotional Foils) | 55 | | "none" on mixed products, unverified | 26 | | **Not to standard** | **9,082 (90.2%)** | - Every non-Premiere set is 100% missing, including the other three Ackbar pages. - Largest gaps: | Set | Pages missing | |---|--:| | Special Edition | 345 | | Premiere (Japanese) | 324 | | Virtual Block 7 | 315 | | Virtual Block 6 | 314 | | Reflections Gold / Remastered | 310 each | | Virtual Block 1 | 305 | | Virtual Block 2 | 275 | | A New Hope | 270 | | Dagobah | 246 | | Hoth | 244 | | Cloud City | 238 | The full table is in the audit `summary.md`, and the per-page list in `gap-by-page.csv` (both are in [`evidence/286/`](https://github.com/swccg-guild/work/tree/main/evidence/286): `audit-before.md`, `audit-before-by-set.csv`, `audit-before.csv`). - **Why:** - Template:Card's `|set_icon=` is free text with no lookup. It prints an empty cell unless someone fills it by hand on each page. - There's no set→icon helper template. ### The "white square" (Bill: "we gotta get rid of that white square") I downloaded every set-icon file and checked its transparency (alpha channel) with Python. The infobox cell is grey-blue (`#e4e8ec`, from MediaWiki:Common.css). The CSS adds no white; the white comes from the image files themselves. - **Opaque white background, so a white square shows:** - Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png, Icon-set-Hoth.png, Icon-set-Dagobah.png, Icon-set-Cloud-City.png - Icon-set-Jabbas-Palace.png, Icon-set-Special-Edition.png, Icon-set-Endor.png, Icon-set-Death-Star-II.png, Icon-set-premium.png - In each, 0% of pixels are transparent and about 70–76% of the border is solid white. - **Opaque and the wrong picture:** [Icon-set-Tatooine.png](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/File:Icon-set-Tatooine.png) is a black-cornered crop from a rules sheet, not the Tatooine symbol printed on Tatooine cards. Side-by-side in `symbol-checks.png`. - **Already transparent:** - VS1-Legacy and VS2O–VS17O set symbols - VB1–VB9 set symbols - PS1-DefensiveShields-set-symbol.png - both Reflections Gold symbols - **Fix:** upload a transparent version of each opaque file as a new revision of the same file name. The white around the symbol is removed; white inside the symbol stays. - Every page that already uses the file then gets the clean version, including Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0, Admiral Ackbar and Admiral Piett. - I made a draft for all 9 opaque Decipher icons on the box (not uploaded). Each went from 0% to 21–23% transparent pixels. - Before/after mock-up of the Death Star II icon on the infobox colour, dark, white and checkerboard backgrounds: `transparency-demo.png`. - **CSS alternative (not recommended):** `mix-blend-mode: multiply` on the icon would hide the white on the grey cell, but it would also darken the light parts of each symbol, and it breaks on dark backgrounds. ### Where the symbol is printed (for the visual checks) - **Decipher cards:** a small round symbol at the right edge of the lore box, just under the destiny number. Episode I cards show the Episode I icon just below it. - The round icon at the top left, beside the title, is the card-type icon (Rebel, Effect, Interrupt and so on), not the set symbol. - **Virtual Modern cards (Bill):** the set symbol is printed at the bottom right of the card: the set number in a ring (blue, or gold on Virtual Set 0 and Virtual Set D). Crops from five sets are in `modern-symbols.png`. - **Virtual Shields (Legacy):** a "D" in a black diamond at the bottom right of the text box (`coruscant-candidates.png`, bottom row). - The Original Virtual Sets and Virtual Blocks already have uploaded, transparent symbol files. ## Decisions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026, in chat; quoted) - **D1, Premiere wording.** Bill: "Premiere had no set icon. It either says None or None (Premiere). Think on this" - **Decided wording: `None (Premiere)`, with Premiere linked to [[Premiere Limited]].** Bill can override this. - **Why:** - It matches the Ackbar format of icon + set name. Ackbar reads "[symbol] Death Star II"; a Premiere card reads "None (Premiere)", saying there is no symbol and which family the card belongs to. - A bare "None" looks like missing data. Today 8,207 pages show an empty cell, so readers have learned to read blanks as gaps. - It reads correctly on every Premiere-family product: Premiere Limited, Premiere Unlimited, the Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game, Japanese Premiere and Japanese Premiere Two-Player. It also works on Premiere cards reprinted inside later products (ESB Two-Player's Premiere cards), where "None" alone would make readers wonder why an ESB card has no symbol. - This applies only when the card itself is a Premiere design with no symbol. It never replaces a missing symbol on other sets. - **D2, Virtual cards are in scope, shown as icon + name, transparent.** Bill: "Absolutely. We show the icon next to it's name like Admiral Ackbar But we gotta get rid of that white square. It should be transparent in some way." - **D3, Virtual Modern location.** Bill: "Virtual Modern has it's set images on the bottom right." - The 30 Virtual Modern symbols (Virtual Set 0–27, D, P) are cropped from the bottom-right corner of the wiki's own card images. Those are 745×1039 faces, so the symbol is about 40 px, plenty for a 20px icon. - Each is cleaned to a transparent background and uploaded as one file per set. - **D4, mixed products.** Bill: "Yes. You have to. Reflections II for its exclusive cards does have it's own symbol as does Ref III" - Each card's symbol is read from its own scan. - Reflections II and Reflections III exclusives get their own set symbols (see `symbol-checks.png`). - Reprints get whatever their scan shows (D9). - There are no Reflections II or III symbol files on the wiki yet, so both need uploads. - **D5, Revised and Japanese printings.** Bill: "I believe they do except for Premiere which had no expansion symbol" - Revised (white-border) and Japanese printings carry the original expansion's symbol. Premiere printings carry none (D1). - The visual check still confirms this on samples. - **D6, display.** Bill: "Icon plus the set name" - Every row shows the transparent icon at 20px linked to the set article, then the set name as a link, exactly as on Ackbar. - **D7, style check.** Bill: "Shouldn't we fix pages that fail a style check? If it's easier to just dest and then fix later we can do that as long as we keep a record and fix immediately afterwards" - Decided: the icon change may go first. Every page that fails the style check is recorded in a backlog file and fixed in a Task that runs immediately after. Details are in R10 and the Plan. - **D8, Japanese pages go onto Template:Card.** Bill (12 Nov, 3:49 PM): "The Japanese pages need to be fixed such that the correct infobox template is used and changes go to it too. … You can make another story for rebuilding, but we aren't going to shy away from doing the right thing" - The 794 hand-made pages (793 Japanese plus the one oversized promo) are rebuilt on Template:Card in their own Story, #287. The "add a hand-made Set icon row" option is dropped. Nobody edits their hand-made tables for this Story. - **Dependency:** #287 blocks the Japanese part of this Story. Once a Japanese page is on Template:Card, it gets its icon from the same lookup as every other card, with no extra edit. Revised (white-border) and Japanese printings carry the original expansion's symbol, Premiere none (D5). This Story's work on the other 9,276 pages goes ahead without waiting. - **D9, always the symbol on the card's own scan.** Bill: "There are 2 versions of a Tragedy Has Occurred. And yes, you should use the set icon you actually see on the page. That is a rare case where the same card name coming back is not actually a reprint" - Every card's Set icon is the symbol printed on that card's own scan, even when the same card name exists in another set. - The two [A Tragedy Has Occurred](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/A_Tragedy_Has_Occurred) cards are a rare case: the same name, but not a reprint. The Coruscant card shows the Coruscant symbol, and [A Tragedy Has Occurred (Reflections III)](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/A_Tragedy_Has_Occurred_(Reflections_III)) shows the Reflections III symbol (`symbol-checks.png`, row 2). - **D10, Coruscant silver ring by default; gold ring only on AI cards.** Bill: "The Coruscant Silver Ring symbol is the default correct symbol to use. The Gold one is for an AI card only (Alternate Image Card)" - `Icon-set-Coruscant.png` is made from the silver-ring symbol (left panel of [File:Coruscant_expansion_icon_rings_centered.png](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/File:Coruscant_expansion_icon_rings_centered.png), labelled "Regular — silver ring"). A separate `Icon-set-Coruscant-AI.png` is made from the gold ring (right panel, "Alternate Image — gold ring"). Transparent drafts of both are on the box (`coruscant-icons-draft.png` shows them on the infobox grey, dark and white). Nothing is uploaded yet. - **AI Coruscant cards exist: 9 pages.** [Darth Maul, Young Apprentice (AI)](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/Darth_Maul,_Young_Apprentice_(AI)), [Mace Windu (AI)](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/Mace_Windu_(AI)), [Master Qui-Gon (AI)](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/Master_Qui-Gon_(AI)), [Maul's Sith Infiltrator (AI)](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/Maul%27s_Sith_Infiltrator_(AI)), [Queen Amidala, Ruler Of Naboo (AI)](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/Queen_Amidala,_Ruler_Of_Naboo_(AI)), [Senator Palpatine (AI)](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/Senator_Palpatine_(AI)), [Supreme Chancellor Valorum (AI)](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/Supreme_Chancellor_Valorum_(AI)), [The Phantom Menace (AI)](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/The_Phantom_Menace_(AI)), [Yoda, Senior Council Member (AI)](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/Yoda,_Senior_Council_Member_(AI)). Their scans show the thicker gold ring (for example [File:Cor-L-macewindu_ai-decipher-archive.jpg](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/File:Cor-L-macewindu_ai-decipher-archive.jpg) next to [File:Cor-L-macewindu-decipher-archive.jpg](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/File:Cor-L-macewindu-decipher-archive.jpg); crops in `ai-ring-check.png`). - **The same applies to Tatooine and Theed Palace AI cards (D9).** Those sets have 9 AI pages each, and their scans also swap the silver ring for a gold one ([Watto (AI)](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/Watto_(AI)), [Boss Nass (AI)](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/Boss_Nass_(AI)); `ai-ring-check.png`). So the files are `Icon-set-Tatooine-AI.png` and `Icon-set-Theed-Palace-AI.png` too. That is 27 AI pages in all. None of them has `ai_mark` set today, so each gets a per-card key (`set_icon=Coruscant AI`, `Tatooine AI`, `Theed Palace AI`). ## Requirements - **R1.** Every card article (non-redirect, in Category:Cards or using Template:Card) shows a **Set icon** row. - **R2.** When the printing carries a set symbol, the row shows the symbol as a transparent image at 20px, linked to the set article, then the set name as a link (D6). For example, `[symbol] Death Star II` on Ackbar. - **R3.** When the printing carries no symbol (Premiere-family designs), the row reads **None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]])** (D1). - **R4.** The icon is the **printed symbol**, not the product (#245): Set = what you opened, Set icon = what is printed on the card. - **R5.** One source of truth: a new `Template:Set icon` maps a set name or icon key to file, link and label, and Template:Card uses it whenever `|set_icon=` is empty. - `|set_icon=` stays as a per-card override that takes a key (`Hoth`, `Reflections III`, `Premium`, `none`). - Existing free-text values, including Ackbar's, keep working. - The Premiere default list is fixed. Its `ESB Two-Player` key never matched, and the Japanese Premiere names are added. - **R6.** **No white square:** every set-icon file the lookup uses has a transparent background. - The 9 opaque Decipher files are re-uploaded as transparent new revisions of the same names. - Icon-set-Tatooine.png is replaced with the real Tatooine symbol. - All new files are transparent from the start. - **R7.** **Missing files are uploaded:** - Coruscant (silver ring, D10) and Theed Palace; - the gold-ring AI versions for Coruscant, Tatooine and Theed Palace (D10); - Reflections II and Reflections III; - Virtual Shields (Legacy) "D"; - the 30 Virtual Modern symbols (D3). - Each File page names its source card scan, and any cited URL has a strict Wayback Preserved copy. - **R8.** Mixed products get a per-card `|set_icon=` key read from each card's scan (D4): Reflections II/III, the Anthologies, Enhanced Premiere/Cloud City/Jabba's Palace, Jedi Pack, Official Tournament Sealed Deck, Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck, Rebel Leader Packs, ESB Two-Player and Promotional Foils. The 27 AI cards get their AI key (D10). Same-name cards in two sets each follow their own scan (D9). - **R9.** The 794 hand-made pages (793 Japanese, 1 oversized promo) get their Set icon through Template:Card after #287 rebuilds them (D8). This Story makes no edits to their hand-made tables. It does check them in the AC1 audit once #287 is Done. - **R10.** **Style-check backlog (D7):** - Before the first edit, the list of card pages that fail `style_lint` is saved in `evidence//lint-backlog.csv`. The 12 Nov baseline is 1,359 pages. - Pages this Story edits may be saved with their old flags, but only if they are in that list. - A follow-up Task (T6), opened at the same time as this Story, fixes every listed page **immediately after** the icon work. This Story closes only when T6 has its own PASS-REPORT. - No page may gain a new flag from this Story's edits. - **R11.** A re-runnable, read-only audit script is committed to billbisco/swccg-wiki (`authoring/`). It produces the per-page CSV, the per-set summary and the transparency check. - **R12.** Wiki gates hold for every touched page, template and file: - edited as the agent's own bot account, with `bot=1` on edits; - section edits with basetimestamp and starttimestamp; - 0 Cite errors; - FlaggedRevs reviewed. - After any file overwrite, every page using the file is purged and its thumbnails checked (overwrites delete old thumbnails; see swccg-wiki accounts-server "Overwriting images"). ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] **AC1** Given the audit script run against live wiki.swccg.com after the work, then the "not to standard" count is **0**: image icon + "None (Premiere)" = total card articles. This includes the 794 hand-made pages, counted once #287 is Done (D8). - Evidence: `evidence//audit-after.csv` and `audit-after.md`. - [ ] **AC2** Given a Template:Card page with no `|set_icon=` and a mapped `|set=`, when rendered, then the Set icon cell holds the set's icon `` (20px, linked to the set article) followed by the set name link. - Evidence: `action=parse` of one card per set (`render-per-set.json`). - [ ] **AC3** Given [[Admiral Ackbar]] and [[Admiral Piett]] (override present), they still show the Death Star II symbol while Set stays the DS2 starter deck. Given a mixed-product card with `set_icon=`, the keyed icon renders. - [ ] **AC4** **No white square:** every file `Template:Set icon` uses passes an alpha check, with corner pixels fully transparent and under 5% opaque near-white pixels in the outer ring of the image. Screenshots of the Ackbar row and one card per era on a light and a dark background show no box behind the icon. - Evidence: `alpha-check.csv`, `samples/no-white-square-*.png`. - [ ] **AC5** **Visual check against the printed card:** for every set in the per-set table, at least one sampled card page (three for sets of 100 or more cards) shows the same symbol as the card scan on that page. The reviewer looks at: - **Decipher:** the right edge of the lore box, under the destiny number; - **Virtual Modern:** the bottom right of the card; - **Virtual Shields:** the bottom right of the text box; - **Original VS and Virtual Blocks:** the slip's set symbol. - Evidence: `samples/.png` (scan crop next to the rendered row), each 500 KB or less. - [ ] **AC6** Given a Premiere-family card, the row reads "None (Premiere)" with Premiere linked, and no Premiere-family card shows a symbol image. - [ ] **AC11** Given any regular Coruscant card, the row shows the silver-ring Coruscant icon. Given each of the 27 AI cards (Coruscant, Tatooine, Theed Palace), the row shows that set's gold-ring AI icon. Given both [A Tragedy Has Occurred](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/A_Tragedy_Has_Occurred) pages, each shows the symbol on its own scan (Coruscant; Reflections III). - Evidence: `samples/ai-and-same-name.png`. - [ ] **AC7** Every new or replaced icon File page names its source card scan and passes the strict Wayback check for any cited URL. After each overwrite, a purge and a thumbnail 200 check are done on the pages using the file. - Evidence: `files.md`, `thumb-check.txt`. - [ ] **AC8** Rendered HTML of a 50-page random sample, before and after, differs only inside the Set icon row. - Evidence: `render-diff.txt`. - [ ] **AC9** `lint-backlog.csv` exists before the first edit. - Every page this Story edits has no flags beyond its backlog entry. - Template:Card, its /doc and sandbox, and Template:Set icon lint 0. - T6 has fixed every backlog page and posted its own PASS-REPORT, with the final `style_lint` run at 0 on all of them. - Evidence: `lint-before.txt`, `lint-after.txt`. - [ ] **AC10** Template:Card/doc documents the lookup, the override keys, the "None (Premiere)" rule, how to add a new set's icon, and the transparency rule. Before/after/diff screenshots of the template are attached. ## Out of scope - Redesigning Set = product vs icon (#245) and same-version multi-product cards (#244). This Story only uses their rule. - Categories by icon (#245 R6). - Changing a symbol's artwork beyond removing its background. - CardMaker set symbols and GEMP. - Infobox rows other than Set icon. - Converting the Japanese pages to Template:Card: that is #287 (D8). - Fan/custom sets. ## Open questions None. Bill answered all of them on 12 Nov 2026. Per AGENTS.md the questions stay, with his answers under them. - **Q-A, Japanese pages: add a row, or rebuild on the card template?** Answered: rebuild them on Template:Card in a separate Story (D8, #287). - **Q-B, A Tragedy Has Occurred (Reflections III) shows the Reflections III symbol, not Coruscant's.** Answered: use the symbol on each card's own scan; the two are a same-name non-reprint (D9). - **Q-C, Coruscant symbol file.** Answered: silver ring by default, gold ring for AI cards only (D10). Theed Palace and Virtual Shields get new transparent files from their scans, as recommended. ## Plan - **Approach:** 1. Save the audit baseline and `lint-backlog.csv`. 2. Make transparent icon files: 9 re-uploads, a Tatooine replacement, and about 39 new ones (Coruscant silver ring, Theed Palace, 3 gold-ring AI icons, Reflections II, Reflections III, Virtual Shields, 30 Virtual Modern, plus any Premium/Anthology symbol the scans show). Upload them, then purge the pages that use them and check thumbnails. 3. Build `Template:Set icon` and the Template:Card fallback in `Template:Card/sandbox`, prove them on test renders, publish, and review once in FlaggedRevs. 4. Fill the mixed-product cards and the 27 AI cards with `set_icon=` from their scans (about 410 pages). 5. After #287 is Done, audit the 794 rebuilt pages (no edits from this Story; D8). 6. Rerun the audit until it reports 0. 7. T6: fix the lint backlog immediately after. - **Repos / files touched:** - wiki.swccg.com: Template:Card, /doc and /sandbox, new Template:Set icon, about 49 File pages, about 410 card pages, and the T6 backlog pages. The Japanese pages are edited by #287, not here. - billbisco/swccg-wiki: `authoring/` audit, fill and transparency scripts, `ops/wayback/queue.txt`, `wiki-docs/HANDOFF.md`. - swccg-guild/work: `evidence//`. - Skill `swccg-wiki` (card infobox note). - **Breakdown (Tasks):** - T1: transparent icon files and uploads. - T2: Template:Set icon and the Template:Card fallback via the sandbox. - T3: mixed-product per-card fill. - T4: Japanese pages: audit only, after #287 (blocked by #287). - T5: audit, visual checks and evidence. - T6: style-check backlog fixes, run immediately after T2–T4. - **Risks:** - **File overwrites delete old thumbnails.** About 10k pages must be purged and spot-checked, or icons show broken. Do it a few minutes after the upload, per the swccg-wiki overwrite note. - **Template:Card changes often** (5 edits on 12 Nov alone), so build in the sandbox and use basetimestamp. - **Job queue:** about 10k pages re-render. - **FlaggedRevs:** check that stable versions pick up the template change. - **Identity:** (V) pages get the Virtual set's symbol, not the underlying Decipher card's (swccg-card-identity). PC Errata and Decipher Errata pages inherit the printing's set. - Nothing is deleted, and there are no server changes. - **Verification (one line per AC):** - AC1: rerun the audit. - AC2: per-set parse. - AC3: Ackbar, Piett and a keyed card. - AC4: alpha check plus light and dark screenshots. - AC5: scan-vs-row samples at the printed location. - AC6: Premiere sample parse. - AC7: File page sources, Wayback check and thumbnail check. - AC8: 50-page render diff. - AC9: lint before/after plus the T6 PASS-REPORT. - AC10: /doc diff and screenshots. - AC11: AI and same-name sample renders next to their scans. ## Style check explained (for Bill; background to D7 and R10) - **What it is:** `style_lint.py` (billbisco/swccg-wiki `authoring/`) is the house style check every editor runs before saving a page. It reads the page's wikitext and prints one line ("flag") per problem. The rule is to save only at 0 flags, and to fix the old flags on any page you touch. - **What it checks:** - **ARCHIVE:** each cited web address must have an Internet Archive "Preserved copy" inside the same citation. - **HEADING:** banned headings such as a hand-written `== Notes ==`. - **BANNED:** hedge and meta words in article text ("probably", "this page", "unclear"…). - **CAPTION:** captions over 12 words, or ones that describe the image. - **EMAIL:** personal email addresses. - **REF:** empty citations. - **Real numbers (all 10,070 card pages, live wikitext 12 Nov, current lint from billbisco/swccg-wiki):** - **1,359 pages (13.5%)** have at least one flag, 2,934 flags in all. - 2,875 of those flags are **ARCHIVE** (a cited link with no Preserved copy). By site: GitHub holotable card images 1,691, res.starwarsccg.org 555, forum.starwarsccg.org 395, scomp 143, www.starwarsccg.org 53, YouTube 34. - 51 are **HEADING** (a hand-written "Notes" heading), 7 are **BANNED** ("this page" written outside the Versions row's bold), and 1 is **CAPTION**. - Examples: - [4-LOM With Concussion Rifle (V) (Virtual Block 6)](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/4-LOM_With_Concussion_Rifle_(V)_(Virtual_Block_6)) cites a forum post with no Preserved copy. - [Arica (V) (Virtual Block 4)](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/Arica_(V)_(Virtual_Block_4)) has a "Notes" heading. - [Great Warrior](https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/Great_Warrior) has "this page" outside the bold. - **Pages this Story would edit by hand (about 410 after D8):** about 30 fail (mixed-product pages). The 35 failing Japanese pages move to #287's backlog. - In a random sample of 30 of them, 1 failed, with one ARCHIVE flag. - The template route changes no page text, so the other ~1,290 flagged pages aren't "touched" by this Story. They're still real defects, and T6 fixes them too. - **Which order is easier:** icon first, then fix right after (Bill's allowed option). - Almost all fixes are ARCHIVE fixes, which mean making and checking Wayback captures. Those run through a queue and can take hours or days per batch. - Holding the icon pass until every capture lands would stall it for no benefit, since the two jobs don't touch the same text. - So: save the backlog list first, run the icon work, and start T6 the same day. ## Evidence required [`evidence/286/`](https://github.com/swccg-guild/work/tree/main/evidence/286) already holds the baseline (audit, lint backlog, transparency demo, icon drafts, symbol checks). After the work it also holds: - `audit-before.*` and `audit-after.*` - `lint-backlog.csv`, `lint-before.txt` and `lint-after.txt` - `alpha-check.csv` - `render-per-set.json` - `samples/*.png` (scan crop next to the rendered row; light/dark no-white-square shots) - `render-diff.txt` - `files.md` - `thumb-check.txt` - before/after/diff screenshots of Template:Card and one card per era The wiki has no Test server, so the Template:Card/sandbox renders stand in for Test. Done = live on the wiki with the AC1 audit at 0 and T6's PASS-REPORT posted.
